cards.name: Summer Academy
cards.description: Students participate in six weeks of project-based reading, math and science instruction, swimming, arts activities and field trips. Older students explore themed Summer LABS activities with community partners.

financial_aid.text: 100% of students qualify for free and reduced lunches; and attend Horizons on a tuition-free basis

lunch.text: Every Horizons student receives a minimum of two meals and one snack daily

transportation.text: We commit to providing a high-quality and accessible program experience through round-trip transportation, meals (breakfast, lunch, and snacks) to fuel our students’ day, and all teaching and learning supplies students need to fully participate.

cards.review_notes: The Summer Academy page says grades K–8 without a grade basis; the explicitly dated 2026 volunteer page says students have completed kindergarten through eighth grade, and the October 2026 Summer LABS blog confirms rising first through ninth graders. Grades use the completed basis from the 2026 volunteer page. Dates also come from that page. Its 8:00–3:00 hours are explicitly volunteer hours, so camper hours are left null. Enrollment is a long-term, nominated-student model rather than ordinary public camp registration; eligibility and nomination procedures should be checked with the provider.
